findingsCorrected.finding: Extraction guidance protected evaluation order/count but did not explicitly account for changed compile-time overload selection when a helper broadens declared types.
findingsCorrected.evidence: JLS25§15.12.2 plus compiled/runtime/javap probe: same char[] yields OK through append(char[]) and array object representation through Object helper; typed Receipt audit selects a different effect route after widening.
findingsCorrected.consequence: A supposedly structural cleanup can compile and preserve event counts while changing output or the called effect.
findingsCorrected.fix: Short visible rule plus conditional reference: follow receiver/argument declarations, selected member and discriminating result/effect evidence; preserve a meaningful helper's type or retain clearer inline code.

findingsCorrected.consequence: A universal 'always use the concrete runtime type' correction breaks generic original behavior and potentially accepted input types.
